text:
karen: Quick sync from the gateway design sync: we need a compact playbook for evicting idle streaming sessions to protect pool KV memory. Goal: predictable memory under tail-heavy interactive traffic without surprising clients.

 tom: Two eviction flavors surfaced: gentle (emit trailer with partial marker, allow client retry) and forceful (abort connection, 503 semantics). Gentle keeps contract clearer; forceful saves max memory.

 jin: Important: function-calling/tool invocations mid-stream are dangerous to cut. Trailer must explicitly mark function calls as `confirmed` or `incomplete`; SDKs should treat `incomplete` as a no-op for side effects.

 karen: Proposed minimal trailer schema (HTTP trailer or streaming final JSON chunk): `reclaim-id`, `reason`, `mode`, `partial`, `retry_hint_ms`, `sideeffect_safe`. Example chunk: `{"reclaim-id":"r-2026","reason":"idle","mode":"gentle","partial":true,"retry_hint_ms":1200,"sideeffect_safe":false}`

 claire: Runtime ask: we lack per-stream KV footprint in admission. Suggest cheap bookkeeping: `kv_est_mb` (moving avg), `buffered_bytes`, `last_chunk_ms`. Admission sums `kv_est_mb + buffered_bytes` across streams to estimate pool pressure.

 tom: Config knobs prototype:```yaml
ingress:
  reclaim:
    idle_threshold_ms: 600
    reserve_per_conn_mb: 1
    warmup_ms: 250
    default_mode: gentle  # gentle | forceful
    preserve_header: x-rw-preserve-stream
```

 jin: Billing: mark reclaim events as `partial_abort` and only bill observed tokens. If client retries and completes, charge that attempt separately. Need tracing link from billing events to `reclaim-id` to reconcile.

 ops-bot: RFC updated https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/301 - added reclaim appendix. CI: reclaim-path tests failing. :warning:

 claire: Observability: emit `ingress.stream.reclaim` counter with tags `reason,mode,pool,tenant` and `ingress.stream.footprint_mb` gauge per stream. Also capture histogram `time_since_last_chunk_ms` at reclaim moment.

 karen: UX: allow clients to opt-in to preservation via `x-rw-preserve-stream: duration=ms`; default disabled for PLG, admin-enabled for Dedicated. Warn in docs that preserve consumes pool budget and may be rate-limited.

 tom: Hedging interaction: if hedging/early-fallback is used, ensure only the winning attempt's tokens are billed normally. If reclaim forces additional attempts, those are billed separately. Document the race.

 jin: Implementation plan: (1) runtime: per-stream counters + warmup guard (jin), (2) trailer emitter + reclaim state machine (karen), (3) billing link + trace propagation (finance + jin), (4) tests: chaos reclaim during function-calls + load tests for long-tail holds (claire).

 karen: Safety rule: never gentle-reclaim when `sideeffect_safe` is unknown and function calls occurred in last N ms; prefer forceful abort with explicit logs so platform can investigate.

 claire: Add a small e2e SDK sample: detect `reclaim-id` trailer, check `sideeffect_safe`, and if `partial` then recompose retry with `x-redwood-idempotency` referencing the reclaim-id if client wants resume semantics.

 ops-bot: Tickets filed: INF-5210 (per-stream footprint), INF-5211 (reclaim trailers), INF-5212 (billing markers).

 tom: Action items: land admission counters behind ff, run canary on one Dedicated pool with dashboards, and iterate trailer shape based on SDK feedback.

 karen: Thanks — I'll draft the appendix and a short example for the SDK page.
